clips.title: The story
paras: Along the marsh roads of the Wetlands, Fire Taboo puts Rethiel's concern for the forest into action. The bog beast asks travelers to take the crude flints Mosshide gnolls use to burn living trees, hoping to spare the ancient boughs.

Rethiel the Greenwarden feels the Wetlands' trees as kin. Rot and renewal belong to the swamp, but the Mosshide gnolls cut living timber and cast it into their hearthfires. The groans of those boughs weigh on Rethiel, who can no longer watch the trees suffer in silence.

The Mosshide pack cuts green trees for warmth and territory instead of gathering deadwood. Rethiel seeks to curb their spread without a long war, so the bog beast asks you to take the crude flints carried by stronger gnolls. Without those tools, the pack cannot burn the timber it fells. Rethiel smashes each stone and casts its dust into the sea, where it can never spark the forest again.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the Wetlands, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!
Rid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?

clips.title: Completion
paras: ... Thank you. I will smash these flints and cast them into the sea, so that they may never again be used to burn living wood.
